name: frontend-vibe
description: Infinity Code's seeded frontend playbook: distinctive, animated, tasteful UI instead of generic AI-slop templates.

steps.instruction: Define design tokens first: a 4px spacing scale, one accent color plus a neutral ramp, border radii and shadows as CSS custom properties before writing any component.
Use exactly one display font and one body font; sizes follow a modular scale (1.25 ratio) instead of arbitrary pixel values.
Motion rules: 150-250ms ease-out, animate only transform and opacity, at most one entrance animation per view, and always honor prefers-reduced-motion.
No default framework blue, no gradient headline text, no three-equal-cards-in-a-row layouts, no emoji as icons - these read as AI-generated slop.
Compose asymmetric layouts with deliberate whitespace; let one element per section be oversized or off-grid so the design has a point of view.
Dark surfaces get elevated layering via subtle lightness steps, not borders; light surfaces get depth via soft shadows only.
Interactive elements must have hover, focus-visible and active states; focus rings are never removed, only restyled.
Meet WCAG AA: 4.5:1 text contrast minimum, semantic HTML landmarks, keyboard-reachable controls, alt text for meaningful images.
Empty, loading and error states are designed screens, not afterthoughts; each gets the same visual care as the happy path.
Micro-interactions (button press scale, checklist strike-through, success pulse) are what make a harness feel alive - add at least one per primary interaction.
Ship CSS keyframes before reaching for animation libraries; keep the bundle lean.
Before finishing, visually review the result (screenshot or render) and check it does not look like a generic template.
